title: SlackAppConfiguration
description: This schema defines the Slack App Information

signingSecret.description: Signing Secret of the Application. Confirm that each request comes from Slack by verifying its unique signature.

connectionMode.description: Connection mode for receiving Slack events. Webhook (recommended, and Slack's guidance for production) receives events on a public HTTP endpoint and scales horizontally behind a load balancer. SocketMode uses an outbound WebSocket connection for single-instance deployments that cannot expose a public endpoint (on-prem/firewalled).

appToken.title: App Token
appToken.description: App-level token (xapp-*) required for Socket Mode. Generate from Slack app settings under App-Level Tokens with connections:write scope.
